When Studio uses this runner: documentation review jobs and other Fleet argv work stay on infrastructure you own. Docs review example — remediation clusters dispatch here when Fleet nodes are connected.

One or more Fleet base URLs with bearer auth, priority, and optional CPU/memory ceilings — Lenses skips busy or unhealthy nodes. Env vars still override with a single node.

LAN discovery (ports 18765 / 18766 / 18767)

Scan runs on the Lenses workspace server. Ranges follow each interface's IPv4 address and prefix (same as ip -json addr). Each candidate is probed on 18765, 18766, and 18767 (Caddy often exposes Fleet on *:18767 while Fleet itself stays on loopback). Detection uses GET /v1/health (service: forge-fleet).
